name: Acrisure Arena at Greater Palm Springs

bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 14" x 14" x 6" with no more than 2 pockets, or small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5", are allowed.
allowed: One clear bag up to 14" x 14" x 6" with 2 pockets or fewer
Or one small clutch, purse or wallet up to 4.5" x 6.5"
Medical or diaper bags with leadership approval
prohibited: Pepper spray and other self-defense sprays
Cans, glass, coolers and hard-sided containers
bagPolicy.note: All bags are searched. The arena cannot store prohibited items, so they must go back to your vehicle.

parking.note: Parking at Acrisure Arena offers convenience for various events, from hockey games to concerts. It's advisable to arrive early to secure a spot and avoid last-minute stress.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Acrisure Arena at Greater Palm Springs's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Acrisure Arena at Greater Palm Springs varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: All public entrance doors are accessible. A dedicated Accessible Entrance beside the Ticketmaster Ticket Office provides immediate elevator access; accessible seating and guest assistance are available through Guest Services.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Guests who leave during an event may not re-enter with a used ticket. Limited exceptions may be approved by arena management or a gate supervisor.

ticketPickup.title: Ticket Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The Ticketmaster Ticket Office is at the northeast corner of the Main Concourse beside the front plaza. It opens at 10:00 a.m. on event days and generally remains open until about one hour after the event begins; tickets are delivered digitally.

gates.title: Entrances & Doors
gates.body: All public entrances are accessible. Guests who need prompt elevator access should use the marked Accessible Entrance beside the Ticketmaster Ticket Office; event-specific door times appear on the event page.
